title: A/R Summary sorts accented customer names with their base letter
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Six customers have open invoices on today's date: {Customer-A}, {Customer-B}, {Customer-C}, {Customer-D}, {Customer-E} and {Customer-F}. {Customer-B} and {Customer-E} start with a capital accented letter.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-03 Eagle, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-03 Émile's, {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-03 Emma, {Customer-D} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-03 Fargo, {Customer-E} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-03 Øster and {Customer-F} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-03 Ozone.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Without clicking any column header, find the six customers in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: all six customers are listed, reading from top to bottom {Customer-A}, {Customer-B}, {Customer-C}, {Customer-D}, {Customer-E}, {Customer-F}. With the example names, "Émile's" sorts among the E names (between "Eagle" and "Emma"), not after the Z names, and "Øster" sorts as an O, before "Ozone".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • S1-R1: “A/R Summary opens with customers in name order, A to Z; A/P Summary opens with vendors in name order, A to Z.”
  • S1-R3: “Accented letters sort with their base letter: "Émile's" sorts among the E names (é è ê ë sort as e, á à â ä ã å as a, ç as c, ñ as n, ö ó ò ô õ ø as o, ü ú ù û as u, í ì î ï as i, ý ÿ as y, ß as ss, æ as ae, œ as oe, in both cases).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p1-a-r-aging-summary-opens-a-to-z.png: figure "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"
  • ar-ap-p7-a-r-summary-date-only.png: figure "A/R Aging Summary as it opens today" (Production (before)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "Customer name order the way QuickBooks sorts ("10 Trucking" before "2 Trucking"), marked on the Customer header. S1-R1, S1-R2, S1-R4, S1-R7, S1-R8." (caption of "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z")
  • "Customers come back in no set order, and no column header can be clicked to sort." (caption of "A/R Aging Summary as it opens today")
